title: WebSocketControlMessage
description: Control messages sent by the client to the server over a `/vt/v1/subscribe` WebSocket connection. The first control message MUST be a `subscribe`; a subsequent `subscribe` replaces the active subscription; an `unsubscribe` (or socket close) stops notifications. See `### Websocket Subscriptions` in the indexer spec.

Subscribe.description: Subscribe (or replace the current subscription) for the WebSocket connection.

dids.description: DIDs to subscribe to. Omit (or send an empty array) to subscribe to every DID indexed by this resolver.

Unsubscribe.description: Stop receiving notifications on this connection. Equivalent to closing the socket.

Channels.description: Map from channel name to either a boolean (use defaults) or a sub-options object. Channels not listed are excluded from the stream.

trust.description: Trigger when a re-evaluation event ([IDX-VT-EVAL-3]: state-affecting message, consumed TriggerResolver, or dependency cascade) changes any of the persisted trust-core fields (`trusted`, `evaluatedAtTime`, `evaluatedAtBlock`, `expiresAtTime`, `corporationId`). The new values are delivered inline (see `changes.schema.json` `#/$defs/TrustChange`). The top-level `corporationId` rotation (DID re-binding to a different Corporation) is signalled here. A passive wall-clock crossing of `expiresAtTime` is not a change event.

corporation.description: Trigger on creation or removal (the DID is bound to a Corporation, or that binding ends — e.g. a `Corporation.did` rotation away from this DID), a slash event, CGF rotation, or any CGF document change of the singular `corporation` object the DID represents. Per VPR's per-Corporation `did` uniqueness invariant, a DID is the `did` of at most one Corporation. The top-level `corporationId` scalar itself (the binding "this DID is operated by *that* Corp") is part of the `trust` channel and is not gated separately. Sub-flag `includeDepositChanges` adds notifications for plain `deposit` Coin-amount fluctuations on the represented Corporation.

participations.description: Trigger on Participant entries being created or transitioning state. Sub-flags add notifications for `weight` fluctuations and high-frequency counter changes.

ecsCredentials.description: Trigger when an ECS credential issued to or by the DID is added, replaced, or invalidated.

presentations.description: Trigger when a `LinkedVerifiablePresentation` referenced by the DID Document is added or removed, or its `vtcCredentialIds[]` set changes. Changes confined to `unresolvableCredentialIds[]` or `invalidCredentialIds[]` are NOT notified.

services.description: Trigger when a non-LinkedVerifiablePresentation service entry in the DID Document changes (DIDComm, MCP, A2A, VsAgentAdminAPI, …).

ecosystems.description: Trigger when an Ecosystem entry the DID represents is created, archived, or its embedded schemas change. Sub-flags add notifications for high-frequency counter changes.

includeDepositChanges.description: When true, changes in the represented Corporation's `deposit` Coin amount trigger a notification (independent of slash events, which always trigger).

includeWeightChanges.description: When true, changes in a Participant's `weight` Coin amount trigger a notification.

includeParticipantCounts.description: When true, changes in `participants[role]` counters trigger a notification.

includeIssuedCredentials.description: When true, changes in the `issuedCredentials` counter trigger a notification.

includeVerifiedCredentials.description: When true, changes in the `verifiedCredentials` counter trigger a notification.

includeParticipantCounts.description: When true, changes in the ecosystem-level `participants[role]` counters trigger a notification.

includeIssuedCredentials.description: When true, changes in the ecosystem-level `issuedCredentials` counter trigger a notification.

includeVerifiedCredentials.description: When true, changes in the ecosystem-level `verifiedCredentials` counter trigger a notification.
